title: Securities Dealings Policy

tiers.name: 29Metals Personnel
tiers.description: All 29Metals Directors and employees, as well as contractors and consultants to 29Metals with access to sensitive information. All substantive prohibitions (Blackout Periods, short-term dealing, short selling, margin lending, hedging and derivatives) and the clearance requirement apply uniformly to this tier.

tiers.name: Restricted Persons
tiers.description: Each 29Metals Director (including the CEO), each member of the Executive Leadership Team and their direct reports, employees with the role classification/title 'general manager', 'group manager' or 'head of', and each member of the Investor Relations team; the Board may designate additional persons. Distinguished only for identification of the applicable Clearance Officer.

tiers.name: Connected Persons
tiers.description: Family members (spouse or partner, dependent children and other relatives living in the same house) and companies, trusts, partnerships or other entities managed or directly or indirectly controlled by the 29Metals Personnel or a family member, or set up for their benefit.

definitions.hedging_definition: hedging or derivatives (such as caps, collars, warrants or similar products) or other products which alter the economic benefit or risk derived by them in relation to any 29Metals securities held by or on behalf of them

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The Board may, in its absolute discretion, designate additional periods as Blackout Periods. The designation is confidential to 29Metals and must not be disclosed outside the Company, including by inadvertent disclosure such as off-the-cuff remarks to a professional contact.

rules.detail: Outright ban on derivatives over 29Metals securities of any kind, applying uniformly regardless of vesting status; no clearance route is offered for this category, unlike ordinary dealings.
rules.evidence: 29Metals Personnel are not permitted to use hedging or derivatives (such as caps, collars, warrants or similar products) or other products which alter the economic benefit or risk derived by them in relation to any 29Metals securities held by or on behalf of them.

rules.detail: Same clause as derivatives; hedging is named alongside derivatives and banned outright with no vesting distinction and no exemption authority.

rules.detail: Monetisation is not named, but a prepaid forward or similar structure that alters the economic benefit or risk of the holding falls within the catch-all in the hedging/derivatives ban.

rules.detail: Outright ban on transactions that are, or might reasonably be perceived to be, short selling.
rules.evidence: 29Metals Personnel are not permitted to enter transactions involving 29Metals securities that are, or might reasonably be perceived to be, short selling.

rules.detail: Ban is not framed around the word 'margin loan' alone; it prohibits any funding arrangement, however described, where the lender is granted power to sell or compel the sale of the 29Metals securities held by the individual. Margin lending is given as an example.
rules.evidence: 29Metals Personnel are not permitted to enter into funding arrangements where the lender is granted the power to sell or compel the sale of 29Metals securities held by the 29Metals Personnel. Such funding arrangements may include margin lending where 29Metals securities act as security against the loan.

rules.detail: Granting a lender the power to sell or compel sale of the shares (the functional equivalent of an enforceable security interest) is banned; the 'dealing' definition itself does not separately mention encumbrance, so this prohibition is the only source of the restriction.
rules.evidence: 29Metals Personnel are not permitted to enter into funding arrangements where the lender is granted the power to sell or compel the sale of 29Metals securities held by the 29Metals Personnel.

rules.detail: Any secured financing arrangement (not limited to formal margin loans) in respect of 29Metals securities is banned where the lender has power to sell or compel sale on default, which is the ordinary feature of a secured loan.
rules.evidence: Such funding arrangements may include margin lending where 29Metals securities act as security against the loan.

exemption_authority: The Board may designate additional confidential Blackout Periods and may determine that dealing is permitted during a cleansed active capital raising. The Clearance Officer's decision on any clearance application, including hardship/court-order exceptions to a Blackout Period (which are available only for disposals, not acquisitions or derivatives), is final and exercised in its sole discretion; there is no exemption authority for the hedging/derivatives or margin lending prohibitions.

bespoke_clauses.clause: 29Metals Personnel are not permitted to use hedging or derivatives (such as caps, collars, warrants or similar products) or other products which alter the economic benefit or risk derived by them in relation to any 29Metals securities held by or on behalf of them.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Both legs of a funded collar (purchased put, written call) are expressly named derivatives products and are banned outright for all personnel and Connected Persons regardless of vesting, with no clearance or exemption route.

bespoke_clauses.topic: secured financing / power to compel sale
bespoke_clauses.clause: 29Metals Personnel are not permitted to enter into funding arrangements where the lender is granted the power to sell or compel the sale of 29Metals securities held by the 29Metals Personnel.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A bank loan secured on the collared shares in the ordinary way (giving the bank enforcement/sale rights on default) is itself prohibited, independent of the derivatives ban, so the financing leg fails even if the collar were somehow permitted.

bespoke_clauses.clause: If the market was aware of all the current circumstances, could the proposed dealing be perceived by the market as taking advantage of my position in an inappropriate way? ... Where any approval is required for a dealing under this Policy, approval will not be granted where the dealing would not satisfy the Front Page Test.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even for ordinary share dealings that do obtain clearance, a subjective reputational filter applies on top of the objective rules, adding an extra veto point for any bank-related transaction.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The designation of an additional Blackout Period is confidential to 29Metals and must not be disclosed outside of the Company.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: An undisclosed extra blackout could freeze any dealing (were derivatives ever permitted) at a time the bank cannot verify, adding execution timing risk.

bespoke_clauses.clause: This Policy also extends to persons with whom 29Metals Personnel have a close relationship or connection (a 'Connected Person') ... companies, trusts, partnerships or other entities which are managed, or directly or indirectly controlled, by the 29Metals Personnel or a family member, or were set up for the benefit of the 29Metals Personnel or a family member.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Routing the collar or the loan through a family trust or controlled entity does not avoid the hedging/derivatives or secured financing bans.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Clearance cannot be obtained for an acquisition of securities for exceptional circumstances.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even the narrow hardship/court-order carve-out from a Blackout Period could not be used to enter into the put or call legs of a collar (an acquisition/creation of rights), only to sell existing shares outright.

summary: A funded equity collar is not possible under this policy. Section 3.3 imposes an outright, unconditional ban on 'hedging or derivatives (such as caps, collars, warrants or similar products) or other products which alter the economic benefit or risk' of any 29Metals securities held by any 29Metals Personnel or their Connected Persons, with no vesting distinction, no clearance mechanism and no exemption authority. Independently, the policy bans any funding arrangement, however structured, in which the lender is granted power to sell or compel the sale of the pledged 29Metals securities, which would catch the standard security package behind a bank loan secured on the collared shares. Ordinary share sales and purchases remain permitted with prior written clearance from the applicable Clearance Officer (Chair of the Board, Audit/Governance & Risk Chair, or CEO for Restricted Persons; Company Secretary for others), outside the quarterly, half-year and annual Blackout Periods and any confidential additional blackout, and subject to a six-month short-term dealing restriction and a subjective 'Front Page Test'. Because both the derivative legs and the secured loan leg are expressly and separately prohibited, there is no combination of clearance or hardship exception that would make a funded collar available to a director or executive of this company.
